minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, May 17th, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:04 AM on Wednesday, May 17th, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, and Jenny Jolly.

  Members Absent: Scott Snider, Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan and Rafaela Giles.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.

  Guest Present: None.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, April 19th,
  2023, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Diana Mendez, Mobility Manager, PVTA.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Grab-n-Go Meals: Meals were distributed to an average of 156 participants per week
  in April.

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 43 participants per week in
  April.

  Meals on Wheels: 590 meals served to 40 La Verne recipients in April.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of April was $1,630.61.
  The average attendance for April was 69 players per week.

5. Account Balance: $7,728.40.

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Classes going well. Registration will be June 2nd.
 8. Aging Next: April total number of La Verne residents served was 6 (via Joslyn
  Center and Aging Next office).

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Roses are being added to Veterans Hall. The Aquatic Center will
  open on June 12th.

10. Upcoming Events:
  - Monday, May 22nd – Excursion: Forever Wild Exotic
  Animal Sanctuary, 8:45 AM-4:00 PM
  - Monday, May 29th – Memorial Day Ceremony, 11:00AM
  - Tuesday, May 30th – Volunteer Recognition Luncheon,
  10:00 AM-12:45 PM
  - Wednesday, June 7th – Senior Seminar: 10 Tips to Boost Your Energy–
  Humana, 9:30 AM
  - Wednesday, June 7th – Excursion: Long Beach Gondola
  Getaway, 10:30 AM-4:30 PM
  - Sunday, June 11th – Concerts in the Park, 6:30PM
  - Monday, June 12th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
  - Tuesday, June 20th – Excursion: Paramount Pictures Studio Tour &
  Universal City Walk, 9:45 AM-6:45 PM

11. Public Comments: May have a new member for the Senior Advisory Committee.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 10:45 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, June 21st 10:00 AM.
